q1: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2: SELECT IFNULL(( SELECT M1.NUM FROM MYNUMBERS M1 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM MYNUMBERS M2 WHERE M2.NUM = M1.NUM) = 1 ORDER BY NUM DESC LIMIT 1), NULL ) AS NUM
